result.text: We used molecular dynamics with LAMMPS to equilibrate an Al sample under isobaric, isothermal conditions (NPT ensemble) at 300 K and 1 atm for 500 ps. The initial conditions were obtained by replicating the fcc unit cell 5 times in each direction. We used Nose-Hoover thermostat and barostat with relaxation timescales of 0.1 and 1 ps, respectively. All MD simulations were performed using LAMMPS. Atomic interactions were obtained using an embedded atom model developed by Ercolessi and Adams [1] obtained from OpenKIM.org. [1] EAM alloy potential for Al developed by Ercolessi and Adams (1994) v002. OpenKIM. 2018. doi:10.25950/376e3e7e.

result.sanitized_script:
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.982
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * prompt1.potential Al
velocity all create 300 12345 mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
timestep 0.001
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 1.01325 1.01325 1
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step time temp press pe ke etotal vol
run 500000

result.text:
Domain review against method description:

- Units: metal units correct. Timestep 0.001 ps (1 fs) is appropriate for Al. Pressure 1.01325 bar = 1 atm in metal units. Temperature 300 K. All consistent with description.
- Geometry: region block 0 5 0 5 0 5 in FCC lattice units gives 5x5x5 supercell = 125 unit cells x 4 atoms = 500 atoms. Matches description.
- Boundary conditions: p p p (fully periodic) is correct for bulk NPT equilibration.
- Potential: eam/alloy pair_style with prompt1.potential (Al) correctly implements the Ercolessi-Adams EAM potential referenced in the description.
- Thermostat: Nose-Hoover via fix npt, Tdamp=0.1 ps. Matches described 0.1 ps relaxation timescale.
- Barostat: Nose-Hoover via fix npt, Pdamp=1.0 ps. Matches described 1 ps relaxation timescale.
- Pressure coupling: iso (isotropic). Description says "1 atm" without specifying anisotropic — isotropic is appropriate for FCC bulk equilibration.
- Run length: 500000 steps x 0.001 ps/step = 500 ps. Matches description.
- Lattice parameter: 4.05 Angstrom is close to the experimental Al value (4.049 Angstrom) and is consistent with Ercolessi-Adams parameterization.

No issues found. The script faithfully implements the described NPT equilibration.
